correctness.rationale: Verified scroll parametrization [au:av:bu^2:bv^2:buv], minors xe-yz=xw-ye=zw-e^2=0, local conductor A=k[y,yt,t^2] subset B=k[y,t] and purely inseparable Gamma->L (t->t^2). The normalization is finite and birational, and smooth transverse D has y as uniformizer so its image curve is regular; tangency forces all image maximal-ideal generators to vanish order at least two. Pullback of any set-theoretic hypersurface section supported on C gives rD~mH; primitive H in Pic(S)=ZH+ZF forces D~dH (and excludes singular line L). In char2 s^2 descends as a homogeneous degree-2d polynomial because e^2=zw; this supplies multiplicity two and no other support. Restriction of any lower section to Gamma is a Frobenius square; transverse D has simple zeros, forcing r even. Bertini with surjective restriction to Gamma yields all d; adjunction H^2=3, K.H=-5 gives genus. Independent symbolic substitution and determinant checks corroborate example, not universal Bertini.
